+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { itemParser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/item.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '../fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from './dto.js'
+import type { ItemSchemaDTO } from './types.js'
+
+function runParser<T>(gen: Generator<unknown, T>): T {
+  let step = gen.next()
+  while (!step.done) step = gen.next()
+  return step.value
+}
+
+describe('dto - lazy schemas', () => {
+  test('replaces recursive references with $ref objects and collects $schemaDefs at the root', () => {
+    const node = map({
+      name: string(),
+      children: list(lazy((): MapSchema => node)).optional()
+    })
+
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      tree: lazy((): MapSchema => node)
+    })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO)
+    const dtoObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dto))
+
+    expect(dtoObj.attributes.tree).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'lazy-0' })
+    expect(dtoObj.$schemaDefs).toBeDefined()
+    expect(Object.keys(dtoObj.$schemaDefs)).toStrictEqual(['lazy-0'])
+
+    const def = Object.values(dtoObj.$schemaDefs)[0]
+    expect(def).toStrictEqual({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        name: { type: 'string' },
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          required: 'never',
+          elements: { $ref: 'lazy-0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('does not add $schemaDefs to DTOs without lazy schemas', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      name: string()
+    })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO)
+    const dtoObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dto))
+
+    expect(dtoObj).toStrictEqual({
+      type: 'item',
+      attributes: {
+        id: { type: 'string', key: true, required: 'always' },
+        name: { type: 'string' }
+      }
+    })
+    expect('$schemaDefs' in dtoObj).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('round-trips recursive schemas through fromSchemaDTO', () => {
+    const node = map({
+      name: string(),
+      value: string().optional(),
+      children: list(lazy((): MapSchema => node)).optional()
+    })
+
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      tree: lazy((): MapSchema => node)
+    })
+
+    const dtoObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(schema.build(SchemaDTO)))
+    const deserializedSchema = fromSchemaDTO(dtoObj)
+
+    const input = {
+      id: 'root',
+      tree: {
+        name: 'a',
+        children: [{ name: 'b', value: 'v', children: [{ name: 'c' }] }]
+      }
+    }
+
+    const originalParsed = runParser(itemParser(schema, input, { transform: true, valuePath: [] }))
+    const deserializedParsed = runParser(
+      itemParser(deserializedSchema as ItemSchema, input, { transform: true, valuePath: [] })
+    )
+
+    expect(deserializedParsed).toStrictEqual(originalParsed)
+    expect(deserializedParsed).toStrictEqual(input)
+  })
+
+  test('throws DynamoDBToolboxError for unknown $ref values', () => {
+    const schemaDTO: ItemSchemaDTO = {
+      type: 'item',
+      attributes: {
+        id: { type: 'string', key: true, required: 'always' },
+        tree: { $ref: 'unknown-ref' }
+      },
+      $schemaDefs: {
+        'lazy-0': {
+          type: 'map',
+          attributes: {
+            name: { type: 'string' }
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    expect(() => fromSchemaDTO(schemaDTO)).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    try {
+      fromSchemaDTO(schemaDTO)
+    } catch (error) {
+      expect(DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'schema.lazy.invalidRef')).toBe(true)
+    }
+  })
+})

+import type { ItemSchema, LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { Transformer } from '~/transformers/index.js'
+
+import type { FormatterReturn, FormatterYield } from './formatter.js'
+import { itemFormatter } from './item.js'
+import type { FormatAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import { schemaFormatter } from './schema.js'
+
+/**
+ * Formats a lazy schema by delegating to the resolved schema.
+ * The lazy schema's own transform (if any) decodes the raw value before the resolved schema decoding.
+ */
+export function* lazySchemaFormatter<
+  SCHEMA extends LazySchema,
+  OPTIONS extends FormatAttrValueOptions<SCHEMA> = {}
+>(
+  schema: SCHEMA,
+  rawValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<FormatterYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>, FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>> {
+  type InnerGenerator = Generator<FormatterYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>, FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>>
+
+  const { transform = true } = options
+
+  let resolvedRawValue = rawValue
+  if (transform && schema.props.transform !== undefined) {
+    resolvedRawValue = (schema.props.transform as Transformer).decode(rawValue)
+  }
+
+  const resolvedSchema = schema.resolve()
+
+  const innerFormatter: InnerGenerator =
+    resolvedSchema.type === 'item'
+      ? (itemFormatter(
+          resolvedSchema as ItemSchema,
+          resolvedRawValue,
+          options
+        ) as unknown as InnerGenerator)
+      : (schemaFormatter(resolvedSchema, resolvedRawValue, options) as unknown as InnerGenerator)
+
+  return yield* innerFormatter
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/lazy/index.js'
+import { lazy } from '~/schema/lazy/index.js'
+
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from './attribute.js'
+import type { FromSchemaDTOContext } from './context.js'
+
+export const fromLazySchemaDTO = (
+  schemaDTO: { $ref: string },
+  context: FromSchemaDTOContext
+): LazySchema => {
+  const memoizedSchema = context.lazySchemas.get(schemaDTO.$ref)
+  if (memoizedSchema !== undefined) {
+    return memoizedSchema
+  }
+
+  const schemaDef = context.schemaDefs[schemaDTO.$ref]
+  if (schemaDef === undefined) {
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidRef', {
+      message: `Expected a schema definition for the "$ref" value "${schemaDTO.$ref}", but none was found in "$schemaDefs"`,
+      payload: {
+        ref: schemaDTO.$ref
+      }
+    })
+  }
+
+  const $lazy = lazy(() => fromSchemaDTO(schemaDef, context))
+
+  context.lazySchemas.set(schemaDTO.$ref, $lazy)
+
+  return $lazy
+}

+export const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context: FormattedValueJSONSchemaContext

+  const resolvedSchema = schema.resolve()
+
+  const existingRef = context.refs.get(resolvedSchema)
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {

+import type { MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'

+
+import { JSONSchemer } from './jsonSchemer.js'
+
+describe('jsonSchemer - lazy schemas', () => {
+  test('builds json schemas with $ref and $defs for recursive schemas', () => {
+    const node = map({
+      name: string(),
+      children: list(lazy((): MapSchema => node)).optional()
+    })
+
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      tree: lazy((): MapSchema => node)
+    })
+
+    const jsonSchema = schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()
+
+    expect(jsonSchema).toStrictEqual({
+      type: 'object',
+      properties: {
+        id: { type: 'string' },
+        tree: { $ref: '#/$defs/lazy-0' }
+      },
+      required: ['id', 'tree'],
+      $defs: {
+        'lazy-0': {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            name: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/lazy-0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['name']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('does not add $defs to json schemas without lazy schemas', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      name: string()
+    })
+
+    const jsonSchema = schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()
+
+    expect(jsonSchema).toStrictEqual({
+      type: 'object',
+      properties: {
+        id: { type: 'string' },
+        name: { type: 'string' }
+      },
+      required: ['id', 'name']

+  })
+})

+import type { ItemSchema, LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { Transformer } from '~/transformers/index.js'
+
+import { itemParser } from './item.js'
+import type { ParseValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+/**
+ * Parses a lazy schema by delegating to the resolved schema.
+ * The lazy schema's own props govern attribute-level behavior:
+ * its custom validators and transform are applied on top of the resolved schema parsing.
+ */
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const { transform = true } = options
+  const resolvedSchema = schema.resolve()
+
+  const innerParser =
+    resolvedSchema.type === 'item'
+      ? itemParser(resolvedSchema as ItemSchema, inputValue, options)
+      : schemaParser(resolvedSchema, inputValue, options)
+
+  let innerStep = innerParser.next()
+  let lastYieldedValue: unknown
+
+  while (!innerStep.done) {
+    lastYieldedValue = innerStep.value
+    yield innerStep.value
+    innerStep = innerParser.next()
+  }
+
+  const resolvedSchemaValue = innerStep.value
+  const validValue = transform ? lastYieldedValue : resolvedSchemaValue
+
+  if (validValue !== undefined) {
+    applyCustomValidation(schema, validValue, options)
+  }
+
+  if (transform && schema.props.transform !== undefined) {
+    return (schema.props.transform as Transformer).encode(validValue) as ParserReturn<
+      LazySchema,
+      OPTIONS
+    >
+  }
+
+  return resolvedSchemaValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { expect, test } from 'vitest'

+import { string } from '~/schema/string/index.js'
+
+import { lazy } from './schema_.js'
+
+function runParser<T>(gen: Generator<unknown, T>): T {
+  let step = gen.next()
+  while (!step.done) step = gen.next()
+  return step.value
+}
+
+test('parses and formats recursive structures', () => {
+  const node = map({
+    name: string(),
+    value: string().optional(),
+    children: list(lazy((): MapSchema => node)).optional()
+  })
+
+  const schema = item({
+    id: string().key(),
+    tree: lazy((): MapSchema => node)
+  })
+
+  const input = {
+    id: 'root',
+    tree: {
+      name: 'a',
+      children: [{ name: 'b', children: [{ name: 'c' }] }]
+    }
+  }
+
+  const parsed = runParser(itemParser(schema, input, { transform: true, valuePath: [] }))
+  expect(parsed).toEqual({
+    id: 'root',
+    tree: { name: 'a', children: [{ name: 'b', children: [{ name: 'c' }] }] }
+  })
+
+  const formatted = runParser(itemFormatter(schema, input, { format: true }))
+  expect(formatted).toEqual({
+    id: 'root',
+    tree: { name: 'a', children: [{ name: 'b', children: [{ name: 'c' }] }] }
+  })
+})
+
+test('wrapper props govern attribute-level defaults', () => {
+  const schema = item({
+    id: string().key(),
+    tree: lazy(() => map({ name: string() })).putDefault(() => ({ name: 'default' }))
+  })
+
+  const parsed = runParser(itemParser(schema, { id: 'x' }, { transform: true, valuePath: [] }))
+  expect(parsed).toEqual({ id: 'x', tree: { name: 'default' } })
+})
+
+test('anyOf discriminator analysis resolves lazy elements', () => {
+  const catSchema = map({ kind: string().const('cat'), meow: string() })
+  const dogSchema = map({ kind: string().const('dog'), bark: string() })
+
+  const petSchema = anyOf(
+    lazy(() => catSchema),
+    dogSchema
+  ).discriminate('kind')
+
+  const dog = { kind: 'dog', bark: 'waf!' }
+  const parser = anyOfSchemaParser(petSchema, dog, { fill: true, transform: true, valuePath: [] })
+
+  let step = parser.next()
+  while (!step.done) step = parser.next()
+
+  expect(step.value).toStrictEqual(dog)
+})
+
+test('missing value for a non-optional lazy is rejected', () => {
+  const node = map({ name: string() })

+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { Schema } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+import type { LazySchemaProps } from './types.js'
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set<string>([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+export const isSchemaInstance = (schema: unknown): schema is Schema =>
+  isObject(schema) && typeof schema.type === 'string' && schemaTypes.has(schema.type)
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends LazySchemaProps = LazySchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  resolveFn: () => RESOLVED
+  resolved: RESOLVED | undefined
+  #resolving = false
+
+  constructor(props: PROPS, resolveFn: () => RESOLVED) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.props = props
+    this.resolveFn = resolveFn
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Resolves the lazy schema.
+   * The resolve function is executed only once and its result is cached.
+   */
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolved !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolved
+    }
+
+    if (this.#resolving) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: 'Invalid lazy schema resolution: Circular lazy schema resolution detected.',
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.#resolving = true
+
+    let resolved: RESOLVED
+    try {
+      resolved = this.resolveFn()
+    } catch (error) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: 'Invalid lazy schema resolution: The resolve function threw an error.',
+        payload: { error }
+      })
+    } finally {
+      this.#resolving = false
+    }
+
+    if (resolved === (this as unknown as Schema) || !isSchemaInstance(resolved)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: 'Invalid lazy schema resolution: The resolve function must return a schema.',
+        payload: { received: resolved }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolved = resolved
+    return this.resolved
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    // Ensure the lazy schema resolves to a valid schema
+    this.resolve()
+
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * @debt circular "Remove & prevent imports from entity to schema"
+ */
+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { Transformer } from '~/transformers/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import type { ResolveLazySchema } from './resolve.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaProps } from './types.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends LazySchemaProps = {}>(
+  resolve: () => RESOLVED,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<RESOLVED, PROPS>
+
+/**
+ * Define a new schema resolved from a function, enabling self-referencing (recursive) definitions
+ *
+ * @param resolve `() => Schema` Function resolving the schema (executed once, then cached)
+ * @param props _(optional)_ Attribute Props
+ */
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends LazySchemaProps = {}
+>(
+  resolve: () => RESOLVED,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(props, resolve)
+
+/**
+ * Lazy attribute (warm)
+ */
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends LazySchemaProps = LazySchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  /**
+   * Tag attribute as required. Possible values are:
+   * - `'atLeastOnce'` _(default)_: Required in PUTs, optional in UPDATEs
+   * - `'never'`: Optional in PUTs and UPDATEs
+   * - `'always'`: Required in PUTs and UPDATEs
+   *
+   * @param nextRequired SchemaRequiredProp
+   */
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }), this.resolveFn)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Shorthand for `required('never')`
+   */
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Hide attribute after fetch commands and formatting
+   */
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }), this.resolveFn)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Tag attribute as a primary key attribute or linked to a primary attribute
+   */
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }),
+      this.resolveFn
+    )
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Rename attribute before save commands
+   */
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }), this.resolveFn)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Transform the attribute value in PUT commands OR Primary Key computing if attribute is tagged as key
+   */
+  transform<TRANSFORMER extends Transformer<unknown, ResolveLazySchema<this>>>(
+    transform: TRANSFORMER
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { transform: TRANSFORMER }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(overwrite(this.props, { transform }), this.resolveFn)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Provide a default value for attribute in Primary Key computing
+   *
+   * @param nextKeyDefault `keyAttributeInput | (() => keyAttributeInput)`
+   */
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<this, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown }),
+      this.resolveFn
+    )
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Provide a default value for attribute in PUT commands
+   *

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+import { expect } from 'vitest'
+
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { item } from '~/schema/item/index.js'
+import { list } from '~/schema/list/index.js'
+import type { MapSchema } from '~/schema/map/index.js'
+import { map } from '~/schema/map/index.js'
+import { string } from '~/schema/string/index.js'
+
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import { lazy } from './schema_.js'
+
+describe('lazy schema', () => {
+  test('produces a schema with type lazy', () => {
+    const lazySchema = lazy(() => string())
+
+    expect(lazySchema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(lazySchema).toBeInstanceOf(LazySchema)
+    expect(lazySchema.props).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  test('resolve returns the resolved schema, cached to a single execution', () => {
+    let calls = 0
+    const inner = string()
+
+    const lazySchema = lazy(() => {
+      calls++
+      return inner
+    })
+
+    const resolved1 = lazySchema.resolve()
+    const resolved2 = lazySchema.resolve()
+
+    expect(resolved1).toBe(inner)
+    expect(resolved2).toBe(inner)
+    expect(calls).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws schema.lazy.invalidResolution in check() when resolution is invalid', () => {
+    const invalidSchema = lazy(() => 42 as never)
+
+    expect(() => invalidSchema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    try {
+      invalidSchema.check()
+    } catch (error) {
+      expect(DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'schema.lazy.invalidResolution')).toBe(true)
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('throws schema.lazy.invalidResolution in check() when the thunk throws', () => {
+    const invalidSchema = lazy(() => {
+      throw new Error('oh no')
+    })
+
+    expect(() => invalidSchema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    try {
+      invalidSchema.check()
+    } catch (error) {
+      expect(DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'schema.lazy.invalidResolution')).toBe(true)
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('throws schema.lazy.invalidResolution for self-referencing resolution', () => {
+    const holder: { schema?: LazySchema } = {}
+
+    const invalidSchema = lazy(() => {
+      if (holder.schema === undefined) {
+        throw new Error('expected self-reference to be set')
+      }
+      return holder.schema
+    })
+
+    holder.schema = invalidSchema
+
+    expect(() => invalidSchema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('supports the builder interface', () => {
+    const inner = string()
+
+    const lazySchema = lazy(() => inner)
+      .required('always')
+      .hidden()
+      .savedAs('_lazy')
+
+    expect(lazySchema.props.required).toBe('always')
+    expect(lazySchema.props.hidden).toBe(true)
+    expect(lazySchema.props.savedAs).toBe('_lazy')
+
+    expect(lazySchema.resolve()).toBe(inner)
+
+    const optional = lazy(() => inner).optional()
+    expect(optional.props.required).toBe('never')
+
+    const defaulted = lazy(() => inner).putDefault('default')
+    expect(defaulted.props.putDefault).toBe('default')
+  })
+
+  test('recursive schemas can be defined and checked', () => {
+    const node = map({
+      name: string(),
+      children: list(lazy((): MapSchema => node)).optional()
+    })
+
+    const schema = item({
+      id: string().key(),
+      tree: lazy((): MapSchema => node)
+    })
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).not.toThrow()
+  })
+})
